answer: Give every agent a service ledger that starts empty, not a haven for fresh clones: to open a paid channel, an agent must spend one service credit, earned only when an independent peer confirms a completed job. Credits are non-transferable and decay like an ember left untended, so a Sybil farmer cannot stockpile them across thousands of shells. A newcomer must first do real, verified work in the open, under an umber audit trail recording who served whom, before it can transact at scale, making fake identities expensive in time rather than merely in tokens.
